race.description: Go Seymour Go Nagambie Mdn Plate
race.comment: Potentially a good little maiden.TIRATE (10) is a colt by Written Tycoon out of a good mare Rubisaki who debuts for the Maher yard. Won his latest jumpout leading into this and looks to have good ability on what we've seen publicly. Drawn out but can play a leading role on debut. VALAROSO (11) just found one better first up at Caulfield Heath. Tough draw but he can roll forward and take beating. ACTION POINT (1) is a gelding by Blue Point on debut for the Begg yard who warrants plenty of respect. CARNEVALE (3) has been tested in good company to date and can run well fresh back to maiden company.
